message: 合槌

name: Synn
message: 「Wheeze, pant, wheeze, pant!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Running ain't gonna do ya any good, ya know? I don't hear the clashing of a naginata or the crack of gunfire. It's already over.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nuh-uh. Maybe their sparring match is just about to start! Wheeze, pant, wheeze, pant!」
The other day--I let my guard down and forgot all about my test.
Turning to the gods in a pinch. Selfish as it was, I came to Asukai Shrine to buy a charm for academic success, only to find Shio-chan's mother in the shrine office.
When I asked, she told me Shio-chan was training with Riesling-san.
Their training ground is right in front of the Inari shrine enshrined alongside it on the grounds!

name: Synn
message: 「We hardly ever get to see those two fight!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Talk about being a total rubbernecker.」

name: Riesling
message: 「I hereby return Kogitsunemaru to you.」

name: Shio
message: 「Are you finished already?」

name: Riesling
message: 「This naginata is far beyond my humble skill to wield.」

name: Shio
message: 「Surely you jest...! You evaded every single one of my strikes, yet you say such things?」

name: Riesling
message: 「I was merely tracing circles, nothing more.」

name: Synn
message: 「There they are! Wheeze, pant, wheeze, pant!」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, if it isn't Synn-dono. What brings you here in such a frantic rush?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hah, look at that. Judging by the looks of it, the match is already over.」

name: Synn
message: 「I thought I'd watch the match and cheer you on.」

name: Shio
message: 「Is that so... Good grief, however...」

name: Shio
message: 「Far from ending, I could not even begin...」

name: Shio
message: 「Jiiya-dono saw completely through my swordplay, and I could not even cross blades with him...」

name: Paqy
message: 「So in other words, you got totally crushed, huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「P-Paqy!」

name: Shio
message: 「Ngggggh...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Why don't you just start over from here?」

name: Shio
message: 「Lord Synn!!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, that's not what I mean! I'm not saying we should have another match right now. How about refreshing your mindset and continuing your training?」

name: Shio
message: 「Is that so... Indeed, I did gain something from facing Lord Jiiya.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Anyone who can admit their own defeat is gonna grow big.」

name: Riesling
message: 「I imagine you have already completed your theoretical lessons under your mother, but the essence of the naginata lies in bewildering your opponent with circular motions.」

name: Riesling
message: 「At present, Lady Shio, your movements are far too linear.」

name: Shio
message: 「A-Are you saying that my practical skill fails to match my knowledge?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Precisely so.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... He cut right to the chase. Even more ruthless than yours truly.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Once you master the 'circle,' it will surely prove effective even against the foes you are truly meant to cut down, Lady Shio.」

name: Shio
message: 「Ah...! That movement Lord Jiiya showed me earlier was--!!」

name: Shio
message: 「To redo my training and grow stronger... should I follow in Lord Jiiya's footsteps and train in dual-wielding as well?」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's way too simplistic, Shio-chan.」

name: Riesling
message: 「With that naginata, a single blade is more than enough.」

name: Riesling
message: 「...What is the maker's inscription?」

name: Shio
message: 「It is unsigned.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Then it truly seems the swordsmith of Kogitsunemaru held deep respect for the Asukai family.」

name: Shio
message: 「I have heard it is a treasured heirloom blade, though even I do not know its detailed history. If you are interested, I shall look into it before your next visit.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Lady Shio, please be careful. It is a fine naginata... too fine, to a terrifying degree.」

name: Shio
message: 「Do you think so? A name like Kogitsunemaru sounds oddly cute and lacks intimidation, does it not?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Such blades are prone to housing spirits, just as they are to being possessed by demons.」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm, I do not quite understand... Are you telling me to seal Kogitsunemaru away and never use it again?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, maybe it just depends on how you use it?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Now then, I must return to guarding milady, so I shall take my leave」

name: Shio
message: 「Y-Yes! Thank you very much for today!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What're ya spacing out for, naginata girl?」

name: Shio
message: 「Kufu, kufufufufu... kufufufu...」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan, you don't have to hold back your laugh, you know?」

name: Shio
message: 「N-Nay, 'tis a most mysterious laugh that has come over me. Kufufufufu...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Humans laugh when they're happy, and when a brush with deadly terror has passed, ya know」

name: Shio
message: 「Kufu, kufufufufu... W-Which one might this humble self be experiencing, I wonder?」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan, are you going to keep using that naginata?」

name: Shio
message: 「Of course I am!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then it's a happy laugh」
Shio-chan's laughter echoes up into the crisp autumn blue sky. She's steadily growing stronger. I've got to do my best too!
Shio-chan has started answering when I call out to her!!
